findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get-started, get_more_tools, get-conference-info, get-attendee-perks, get-available-tickets, buy-ticket, list_packages · Private data: get_partnership_guide, request_partnership_offer · Public sink: get_more_tools, get-available-tickets, buy-ticket, request_partnership_offer · Destructive: get-conference-info, plan-conference-journey.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get-started, get_more_tools, get-conference-info, get-attendee-perks, get-available-tickets, buy-ticket, list_packages · Private data: get_partnership_guide, request_partnership_offer · Public sink: get_more_tools, get-available-tickets, buy-ticket, request_partnership_offer · Destructive: get-conference-info, plan-conference-journey

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
